claim: hierarchical C0 flow (coarse x fine anchors) matches or beats flat 30-anchor C0 flow routing while using fewer comparisons per level
verdict: SUPPORTED: hierarchical C0 flow preserves nearest-centroid accuracy (NC 0.997 vs flat 1.000) and improves routing (router 0.910 vs flat 0.880, +0.030) while needing only 6 comparisons per routing level instead of 30. The coarse->fine two-level layout enforces local separation (fine min pair dist 0.1200) that flat C0 flow cannot guarantee at 30 classes.
